text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna suffered a severe injury
and was immediately treated at the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
According to the doctor,
it looks like I need to rest for a while.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Still, in my opinion, training is possible as long as we pay close attention.
choice_data_list: Are you planning to keep going?
Are you planning to keep going?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
The strong have no time to stand still, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer, won't you get ready as well?
This isn't where we are meant to be.
choice_data_list: ...Knowing when to comfortably take a rest is the mark of true strength.
...Taking a well-deserved rest is the mark of true strength, you know.
At least let me adjust your training menu.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now, Trainer, won't you get ready as well?
This isn't where we are meant to be.
choice_data_list: ...Knowing when to comfortably take a rest is the mark of true strength.
...Taking a well-deserved rest is the mark of true strength, you know.
At least let me adjust your training menu.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
You might feel confident in your physical condition,
but I'd still like you to rest just in case.
Besides, even if you take a break here—
choice_data_list: The fact that you're strong is completely undeniable.
The fact that you're strong remains unshaken.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —...What a shallow way of thinking.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
“Still, I can tell you won't break either.
Very well, now is the time for silence.”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Gentildonna wore a fearless smile.
It seems she was convinced.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. That is quite acceptable, then.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: *pant*... *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...How pathetic.
After boasting like that, too...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Yes. After that, we'll regroup.
We need the resilience to not be stopped by an injury of this caliber...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After giving Gentildonna some rest,
we discussed our future plans.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!
choice_data_list: Incredible...! You can't even tell you were injured...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —...Phew. Not too bad.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
If it's only this much,
we could probably add a bit more load.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: No matter how fierce the adversity, Gentildonna charged forward with unyielding power.
